en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European small town with cobblestone pavement and two‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and shopfronts on both sides. Awnings extend over the sidewalks, people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible. In the distance are two church towers and a tall spire rising above the roofs. German‑language shop signs are visible on several buildings.
